what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Côte d'Ivoire in Angola: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5940 Ivorian asylum seekers in Angola, 24.5% of all asylum seekers from Côte d'Ivoire.
Refugees from Côte d'Ivoire, a separate group, live mostly in France, Italy, Germany and Liberia.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ivory Coast from 2002 to 2004 and in 2011.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2012 to 2025, begin just after the 2011 conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 47 asylum seekers.
The figure has been 5940 at the end of every year from 2018 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Angola.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Angola only.
